description: Test suite for category boards management in the focalboard server application, including functions for retrieving, creating, and reordering user category boards.

methods.name: TestGetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Unit tests for retrieving user category boards, including cases with no default category, existing categories, and boards.

methods.name: TestCreateBoardsCategory
methods.description: Unit tests for creating a boards category, handling cases with no boards, implicit access, explicit access, and mixed access.

methods.name: TestReorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Unit tests for reordering boards within a category, including normal reordering and error cases.
